instruction: Apply a Gaussian blur effect to the background of the desktop image.

metadata.explanation: GIMP selective blur task variation. Requires applying Gaussian blur specifically to the background area. Infeasible because it requires both identifying background regions and verifying blur application, which needs advanced image analysis beyond current evaluator scope.

llm_judge_reasons: Infeasible marking is correct: Task requires semantic segmentation to identify background vs foreground regions
Infeasible marking is correct: Task requires selective blur detection to verify blur was applied only to specific regions (background)
Current GIMP evaluators only support global image transformations and simple structural comparisons, not regional/selective effects
The concept of 'background' is semantically ambiguous and context-dependent, requiring advanced computer vision beyond current evaluator scope
No existing metrics can distinguish between blurred and non-blurred regions within a single image
